source.section: TC-40 lines 4 to 22 (Instructions PDF p.9 Line 4; PDF p.10 Lines 5 to 20 and the Line 17 table; PDF p.11 Line 22); Line 21 and Qualified Exempt Taxpayer Worksheet lines 1 to 5 (PDF pp.10-11)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 12,000.00 = 12,000.00. Federal taxable income = 12,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 0.00 (floored at 0) (federal senior deduction ignored; Utah starts from federal AGI). TC-40 (single): line 4 federal AGI 12,000.00. Line 5 additions: none, 0.00. Line 6 = 12,000.00 + 0.00 = 12,000.00. Line 7 state tax refund 0.00. Line 8 subtractions 0.00. Line 9 Utah taxable income = 12,000.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 12,000.00. Line 10 = 12,000.00 x 0.045 = 540.00. Lines 11 to 16, by the projection: no dependents; the deduction on line 12 is held as the cap 15,750.00; initial credit = 0.06 x min(line 9 12,000.00, cap 15,750.00) = 0.06 x 12,000.00 = 720.00. The form's line 16 is 0.06 x 15,750.00 = 945.00; line 9 is under the cap, and 6% of it still exceeds the 4.5% tax, so the form and the projection both reach tax 0. Line 17 base phase-out amount 18,213.00. Line 18 = max(0, 12,000.00 - 18,213.00) = 0.00. Line 19 = 0.00 x 0.013 = 0.000. Line 20 = max(0, 720.00 - 0.000) = 720.000. Line 21 worksheet: line 1 federal AGI 12,000.00; line 2 standard deduction 15,750.00; line 3 senior deduction 0.00 (no amount in Utah's sources); line 4 15,750.00; line 5 = max(0, 12,000.00 - 15,750.00) = 0.00. Line 5 is zero, so the filer is exempt: X on line 21 and 0 on line 22 (the form still shows lines 9 and 10 as above). In the expected lines exempt_in_full takes the whole of line 9, 12,000.00, off state income, so state_agi and taxable income are 0.00, and with them the tax and the credits; no credit is claimed. On the form line 10 is 540.00 and line 20 945.00; line 22 is 0 by either road.
